import Std

namespace RangeLedger.LinearProvenance
inductive Expr where | read (endpoint : Nat) | add (a b : Expr) | neg (a : Expr)
def eval (p : Nat → Int) : Expr → Int
  | .read i => p i
  | .add a b => eval p a + eval p b
  | .neg a => -(eval p a)
def coeff (i : Nat) : Expr → Int
  | .read j => if i = j then 1 else 0
  | .add a b => coeff i a + coeff i b
  | .neg a => -(coeff i a)
def bump (p : Nat → Int) (i : Nat) (v : Int) := fun j => p j + (if i = j then v else 0)
theorem derivative (p : Nat → Int) (i : Nat) (v : Int) (e : Expr) :
    eval (bump p i v) e = eval p e + coeff i e * v := by
  induction e with
  | read j => by_cases h : i=j <;> simp [eval,bump,coeff,h]
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [eval,coeff,ha,hb,Int.add_mul]; omega
  | neg a ha => simp only [eval,coeff,ha,Int.neg_mul]; omega

open Expr
def interval (a b : Nat) := add (.read b) (neg (.read a))
def source := add (add (interval 0 3072) (neg (interval 1024 3072))) (interval 1024 4096)
def folded := interval 0 4096
theorem normalize (p : Nat → Int) : eval p source = eval p folded := by
  simp [source,folded,interval,eval]; omega

-- Two distinct endpoints suffice for a direct-potential venue. Each influences
-- the result, so a nonadaptive direct read set recovering the query must include both.
theorem necessary (ks : List Nat) (decodes : ∀ p q : Nat → Int,
    (∀ k ∈ ks, p k = q k) → eval p source = eval q source) (j : Nat) (hj : j = 0 ∨ j = 4096) :
    j ∈ ks := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro absent
  let spike : Nat → Int := fun k => if k = j then 1 else 0
  have eq := decodes (fun _ => 0) spike (fun k hk => by
    have ne : k ≠ j := fun e => absent (e ▸ hk)
    simp [spike,ne])
  rw [normalize,normalize] at eq
  rcases hj with rfl | rfl <;> simp [folded,interval,eval,spike] at eq
theorem coefficients : [0,1024,3072,4096].map (fun k => coeff k source) = [-1,0,0,1] := by decide
#print axioms derivative
#print axioms normalize
#print axioms necessary
#print axioms coefficients
end RangeLedger.LinearProvenance

namespace RangeLedger.SignedStitch

structure Receipt where
  start : Nat
  stop : Nat
  value : Int
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def valid (p : Nat → Int) (r : Receipt) := r.value = p r.stop - p r.start
def rev (r : Receipt) : Receipt := ⟨r.stop,r.start,-r.value⟩
def stitch (a b : Receipt) : Option Receipt :=
  if a.stop = b.start then some ⟨a.start,b.stop,a.value+b.value⟩ else none

theorem reverse_valid (h : valid p r) : valid p (rev r) := by
  simp [valid,rev] at *; omega

theorem stitch_valid (ha : valid p a) (hb : valid p b) (ok : stitch a b = some c) :
    valid p c ∧ c.start = a.start ∧ c.stop = b.stop := by
  unfold stitch at ok
  split at ok
  next eq =>
    cases ok
    refine ⟨?_,rfl,rfl⟩
    simp only [valid] at *; rw [ha,hb,eq]; omega
  next => contradiction

def chain : Receipt → List Receipt → Option Receipt
  | acc, [] => some acc
  | acc, r::rs => (stitch acc r).bind (fun next => chain next rs)

theorem chain_valid (rs : List Receipt) (hs : ∀ r ∈ rs, valid p r)
    (acc : Receipt) (ha : valid p acc) (out : Receipt) (ok : chain acc rs = some out) :
    valid p out := by
  induction rs generalizing acc with
  | nil => cases ok; exact ha
  | cons r rs ih =>
    cases h : stitch acc r with
    | none => simp [chain,h] at ok
    | some next =>
      exact ih (fun x hx => hs x (by simp [hx])) next
        (stitch_valid ha (hs r (by simp)) h).1 (by simpa [chain,h] using ok)

def a : Receipt := ⟨0,3072,120⟩
def b : Receipt := ⟨1024,3072,50⟩
def c : Receipt := ⟨1024,4096,90⟩
theorem before_after : chain a [rev b,c] = some ⟨0,4096,160⟩ ∧ chain a [b,c] = none := by decide
#eval chain a [rev b,c]
#print axioms chain_valid
#print axioms before_after
end RangeLedger.SignedStitch

namespace RangeLedger.CertificateReuse
abbrev World := Nat → Int
def total (p : World) (a b : Nat) := p b - p a
def update (p displacement : World) : World := fun i => p i + displacement i

theorem exact_reuse (p displacement : World) (a b : Nat) :
    total (update p displacement) a b = total p a b ↔ displacement a = displacement b := by
  simp only [total,update]; omega

-- A +7 sample correction followed later by -7 gives a rectangular prefix displacement.
def correction (i : Nat) : Int := if 100 < i ∧ i ≤ 200 then 7 else 0
def pages := [(0,64),(64,128),(128,192),(192,256),(256,320),(320,384),(384,448),(448,512)]
def stale := pages.filter (fun (a,b) => correction a != correction b)
theorem affected : stale = [(64,128),(192,256)] ∧ correction 0 = correction 512 := by decide
theorem minimal (p : World) (a b : Nat) (h : (a,b) ∈ stale) :
    total (update p correction) a b ≠ total p a b := by
  have ne : correction a ≠ correction b := by simpa [stale] using (List.mem_filter.mp h).2
  exact fun eq => ne ((exact_reuse p correction a b).mp eq)
#eval stale
#print axioms exact_reuse
#print axioms minimal
#print axioms affected
end RangeLedger.CertificateReuse

namespace RangeLedger.Identifiable

abbrev World := Nat → Int
def total (p : World) (a b : Nat) := p b - p a
abbrev Catalog := Nat → Nat → Prop

inductive Path (g : Catalog) : Nat → Nat → Prop
  | stay (a) : Path g a a
  | edge {a b} : g a b → Path g a b
  | reverse {a b} : Path g a b → Path g b a
  | join {a b c} : Path g a b → Path g b c → Path g a c

def agrees (g : Catalog) (p q : World) :=
  ∀ a b, g a b → total p a b = total q a b

theorem path_determines {g : Catalog} {a b : Nat} (h : Path g a b)
    (p q : World) (same : agrees g p q) : total p a b = total q a b := by
  induction h with
  | stay => simp [total]
  | edge hg => exact same _ _ hg
  | reverse _ ih => unfold total at *; omega
  | join _ _ hl hr => unfold total at *; omega

-- Translate one connected component by one. Every observed difference survives.
theorem determined_iff (g : Catalog) (a b : Nat) :
    (∀ p q, agrees g p q → total p a b = total q a b) ↔ Path g a b := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro unique
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro missing
    let shifted : World := fun x => if Path g a x then 0 else 1
    have same : agrees g (fun _ => 0) shifted := by
      intro u v huv
      have conn : Path g a u ↔ Path g a v :=
        ⟨fun h => h.join (.edge huv), fun h => h.join (.reverse (.edge huv))⟩
      simp [total,shifted,conn]
    have impossible := unique _ _ same
    simp [total,shifted,Path.stay,missing] at impossible
  · exact fun path p q => path_determines path p q

def observed (a b : Nat) := (a = 0 ∧ b = 100) ∨ (a = 55 ∧ b = 100)
theorem hidden_prefix : Path observed 0 55 :=
  (Path.edge (Or.inl ⟨rfl,rfl⟩)).join (.reverse (.edge (Or.inr ⟨rfl,rfl⟩)))

theorem open_cut : ¬ Path observed 0 56 := by
  intro h
  let spike : World := fun i => if i = 56 then 1 else 0
  have same : agrees observed (fun _ => 0) spike := by
    rintro _ _ (⟨rfl,rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl,rfl⟩) <;> decide
  exact absurd (path_determines h _ _ same) (by decide)

theorem both_receipts_needed (keepLeft : Bool) :
    ¬ Path (fun a b => a = (if keepLeft then 0 else 55) ∧ b = 100) 0 55 := by
  intro path
  let unseen := if keepLeft then 55 else 0
  let spike : World := fun x => if x = unseen then 1 else 0
  have same : agrees (fun a b => a = (if keepLeft then 0 else 55) ∧ b = 100)
      (fun _ => 0) spike := by
    rintro _ _ ⟨rfl,rfl⟩; cases keepLeft <;> decide
  have bad := path_determines path _ _ same
  cases keepLeft <;> simp [total,spike,unseen] at bad

#print axioms both_receipts_needed
#print axioms determined_iff
#print axioms hidden_prefix
#print axioms open_cut
end RangeLedger.Identifiable

namespace RangeLedger.OverlapPlan
abbrev World := Nat → Int
inductive Page where | left | overlap | right deriving DecidableEq, Repr
open Page
def read (p : World) : Page → Int
  | left => p 3072 - p 0
  | overlap => p 3072 - p 1024
  | right => p 4096 - p 1024
def solve (x y z : Int) := x-y+z

theorem reconstruction (p : World) :
    solve (read p left) (read p overlap) (read p right) = p 4096 - p 0 := by
  simp [solve,read]; omega

-- For each missing page there are two indistinguishable worlds with different totals.
def other : Page → World
  | left => fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else 0
  | overlap => fun i => if i = 0 || i = 3072 then 1 else 0
  | right => fun i => if i = 4096 then 1 else 0

theorem essential (missing : Page) :
    (∀ j, j ≠ missing → read (fun _ => 0) j = read (other missing) j) ∧
    other missing 4096 - other missing 0 ≠ 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro j; cases missing <;> cases j <;> decide
  · cases missing <;> decide

theorem control : solve 120 50 90 = 160 ∧ (120+50+90 : Int) ≠ 160 := by decide
#print axioms reconstruction
#print axioms essential
#print axioms control
end RangeLedger.OverlapPlan

namespace RangeLedger.AdaptiveReads

-- Any contiguous range inside one bank may be requested in either direction.
structure Page where
  bank : Fin 4
  lo : Fin 1025
  hi : Fin 1025

abbrev World := Nat → Int
def atPos (p : Page) (x : Fin 1025) := p.bank.val * 1024 + x.val
def read (p : World) (q : Page) := p (atPos q q.hi) - p (atPos q q.lo)

inductive Plan where
  | done (result : Int)
  | ask (q : Page) (next : Int → Plan)

def run (p : World) : Plan → Int × List Nat
  | .done v => (v,[])
  | .ask q next =>
    let (answer, reads) := run p (next (read p q))
    (answer,q.bank.val :: reads)

def correct (s : Plan) := ∀ p, (run p s).1 = p 4096 - p 0
def shift (i : Fin 4) (p : World) : World :=
  fun x => p x + (if (i.val+1)*1024 ≤ x then 1 else 0)

theorem other_bank (i : Fin 4) (p : World) (q : Page) (h : q.bank.val ≠ i.val) :
    read (shift i p) q = read p q := by
  have hlo := q.lo.isLt
  have hhi := q.hi.isLt
  unfold read shift atPos
  split <;> split <;> omega

theorem indistinguishable (i : Fin 4) (p : World) (s : Plan)
    (miss : i.val ∉ (run p s).2) : run (shift i p) s = run p s := by
  induction s with
  | done => rfl
  | ask q next ih =>
    simp only [run,List.mem_cons,not_or] at miss
    have same := other_bank i p q (Ne.symm miss.1)
    simp only [run,same,ih _ miss.2]

theorem touches_every_bank (s : Plan) (ok : correct s) (p : World) (i : Fin 4) :
    i.val ∈ (run p s).2 := by
  apply Classical.byContradiction; intro absent
  have eq := congrArg Prod.fst (indistinguishable i p s absent)
  rw [ok,ok] at eq
  have hi := i.isLt
  simp only [shift] at eq
  split at eq <;> split at eq <;> omega

private theorem count (n : Nat) (xs : List Nat) (h : ∀ i < n, i ∈ xs) : n ≤ xs.length := by
  induction n generalizing xs with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
    have hn := h n (by omega)
    have prev := ih (xs.erase n) (fun i hi => (List.mem_erase_of_ne (Nat.ne_of_lt hi)).mpr (h i (by omega)))
    rw [List.length_erase_of_mem hn] at prev
    have pos := List.length_pos_of_mem hn
    omega

theorem lower_bound (s : Plan) (ok : correct s) (p : World) : 4 ≤ (run p s).2.length :=
  count 4 _ (fun i hi => touches_every_bank s ok p ⟨i,hi⟩)

def whole (b : Fin 4) : Page := ⟨b,0,1024⟩
def four := Plan.ask (whole 0) fun a => .ask (whole 1) fun b =>
  .ask (whole 2) fun c => .ask (whole 3) fun d => .done (a+b+c+d)

theorem attains (p : World) :
    (run p four).1 = p 4096 - p 0 ∧ (run p four).2.length = 4 := by
  change (p 1024 - p 0 + (p 2048 - p 1024) + (p 3072 - p 2048) + (p 4096 - p 3072) =
    p 4096 - p 0) ∧ 4 = 4
  omega
#print axioms lower_bound
#print axioms attains
end RangeLedger.AdaptiveReads

namespace RangeLedger.IntervalBasis
abbrev Answer := Nat → Nat → Int
-- Domain is nonempty half-open intervals inside [0,n].
def additive (f : Answer) := ∀ a b c, a < b → b < c → f a c = f a b + f b c
def singletons (n : Nat) (f g : Answer) := ∀ i < n, f i (i+1) = g i (i+1)

theorem all_queries {f g : Answer} (hf : additive f) (hg : additive g)
    (basis : singletons n f g) (a d : Nat) (bound : a + d + 1 ≤ n) :
    f a (a+d+1) = g a (a+d+1) := by
  induction d with
  | zero => exact basis a (by omega)
  | succ d ih =>
    let b := a+d+1
    have ha : a < b := by dsimp [b]; omega
    change f a (b+1) = g a (b+1)
    rw [hf a b (b+1) ha (by omega),hg a b (b+1) ha (by omega),
      show f a b = g a b from ih (by omega),basis b (by dsimp [b]; omega)]

-- Omit the i-th unit query. A step in the prefix potential hides at exactly i.
def step (i x : Nat) : Int := if i < x then 1 else 0
def spike (i a b : Nat) := step i b - step i a
theorem independently_needed (i : Nat) :
    additive (spike i) ∧ spike i i (i+1) = 1 ∧ ∀ j, j ≠ i → spike i j (j+1) = 0 := by
  refine ⟨fun a b c _ _ => by unfold spike; omega, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [spike,step]
  · intro j ne
    unfold spike step
    split <;> split <;> omega

-- Merge the endpoint classes constrained by each probe. Each merge can remove
-- at most one original label, even if probes use endpoints outside the roster.
abbrev Edge := Nat × Nat
def classes : List Edge → (Nat → Nat) × List Nat
  | [] => (id,[])
  | (a,b)::es =>
    let (label,removed) := classes es
    (fun x => if label x = label b then label a else label x, label b :: removed)

private theorem edges_equal (es : List Edge) : ∀ e ∈ es, (classes es).1 e.1 = (classes es).1 e.2 := by
  induction es with
  | nil => simp
  | cons z es ih =>
    obtain ⟨a,b⟩ := z
    intro e he
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp he with rfl | ht
    · simp [classes]
    · simp only [classes,ih e ht]

private theorem survives (es : List Edge) (x : Nat) (live : x ∉ (classes es).2) :
    (classes es).1 x = x := by
  induction es with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons z es ih =>
    obtain ⟨a,b⟩ := z
    simp only [classes,List.mem_cons,not_or] at live
    simp [classes,ih live.2,live.1]

private theorem merge_count (es : List Edge) : (classes es).2.length = es.length := by
  induction es with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons e es ih => cases e; simp [classes,ih]

private theorem slots (n : Nat) (xs : List Nat) (h : ∀ i < n, i ∈ xs) : n ≤ xs.length := by
  induction n generalizing xs with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
    have hn := h n (by omega)
    have small := ih (xs.erase n) (fun i hi =>
      (List.mem_erase_of_ne (Nat.ne_of_lt hi)).mpr (h i (by omega)))
    rw [List.length_erase_of_mem hn] at small
    have pos := List.length_pos_of_mem hn
    omega

theorem arbitrary_probe_floor (n : Nat) (probes : List Edge)
    (sufficient : ∀ p q : Nat → Int, (∀ e ∈ probes, p e.2-p e.1 = q e.2-q e.1) →
      ∀ i < n, p (i+1)-p i = q (i+1)-q i) : n ≤ probes.length := by
  let c := (classes probes).1
  have agreement : ∀ e ∈ probes, (0 : Int)-0 = (c e.2 : Int)-c e.1 := by
    intro e he; rw [show c e.1 = c e.2 from edges_equal probes e he]; omega
  have determined := sufficient (fun _ => 0) (fun i => (c i : Int)) agreement
  have same : ∀ i ≤ n, c i = c 0 := by
    intro i; induction i with
    | zero => simp
    | succ i ih =>
      intro hi
      have h := determined i (by omega)
      change (0 : Int)-0 = (c (i+1) : Int)-c i at h
      have t := ih (by omega)
      omega
  have lower := slots (n+1) (c 0 :: (classes probes).2) (by
    intro i hi
    by_cases dead : i ∈ (classes probes).2
    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ dead
    · have eq := survives probes i dead
      exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl (eq.symm.trans (same i (by omega)))))
  simp only [List.length_cons,merge_count] at lower
  omega

#print axioms arbitrary_probe_floor
theorem counts : 4096 * 4097 / 2 = 8390656 := by decide
#print axioms all_queries
#print axioms independently_needed
end RangeLedger.IntervalBasis
